settings.help: The Excel workbook in your OneDrive. Its data must be an Excel table: select the data, then Insert → Table.
settings.label: Workbook

settings.help: The table inside the workbook (Excel: Table Design → Table Name).
settings.label: Table

settings.help: A find filter like {"called": false}, or an aggregation pipeline like [{"$match":{"called":false}},{"$sort":{"_id":1}}]. Use {} for every document. Sort on a stable key — pages are read by offset, so without a sort the server may return documents in a different order between pages and some are skipped. Stages that write ($out, $merge) or run JavaScript ($function, $where) are refused.
settings.label: Filter or pipeline

settings.help: The field that identifies a document — used to write outcomes back onto the right one. A document's POSITION is not its identity: without this, a re-ordered or re-filtered read would write onto whichever document now sits in that slot. Must be unique.
settings.label: Key field

settings.help: Where outcomes are written. Leave blank to write back into the collection this source reads from.
settings.label: Write-back collection

settings.help: A single read-only SELECT. Include an ORDER BY on a stable key — pages are read by offset, so without one the database may return rows in a different order between pages and some are skipped.
settings.label: SQL query
settings.placeholder: SELECT id, name, phone FROM leads WHERE called_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

settings.help: The column that uniquely identifies a row — a primary key. Include it in the SELECT above. Required only if you want call outcomes written back; without it the campaign still dials. It MUST be unique: a non-unique key would stamp one call's outcome onto every row that shares the value.
settings.label: Key column (for write-back)

settings.help: The table an outcome is written to. Needed because your query may join several and we will not guess which one to UPDATE.
settings.label: Write-back table
